description: Show how much the sentence lengths in an essay change, since a good rhythm mixes short, medium and long sentences. Input: text. Returns the shortest, longest and average sentence length in words, the standard deviation, how many sentences are short (under 10 words), medium (10 to 24) and long (25 or more), and any runs of 3 or more sentences in a row whose lengths are within 3 words of the first one in the run, with their sentence numbers. Sentence numbers start at 1 and follow the order of the text. This is a simple measure of rhythm, so treat it as a prompt to reread. Example: "Do my sentences all sound the same length?"
name: sentence_variety
title: Sentence variety
